verdict.rationale: Visa ships an official TypeScript Agent Toolkit, published on npm as @visaacceptance/mcp. It integrates with the Vercel AI SDK or runs as an MCP server, and the TAP repo provides an open reference implementation. However, the toolkit's documented scope is Pay by Link and Invoicing rather than the core Intelligent Commerce enrollment, token, instruction and credential endpoints, which are documented only as raw REST calls. Missing for 10: official SDKs wrapping the Intelligent Commerce REST APIs, multi-language SDK coverage, SDK reference docs for the IC flows, and independent hands-on corroboration of building with the SDK.
